intent: A document view for an invoice or a credit note, not a PDF engine: header with status and actions, bill-to and dates, line items, totals and one line about payment. A credit note always names the invoice it reduces. Built on kit Table, Badge, Button and Empty.
useWhen: show one invoice or credit note inside the product
issue, send or record payment on an invoice
show what a credit note reduces
doNotUseWhen: a list of charges over time — the billing-schedule pattern

relatedInvoiceId.note: Credit notes: the invoice it reduces.

lines.note: { id, description, quantity, unitPrice, amount }[]; money pre-formatted.

footnote.note: Paid on, overdue reminder, voided, or what the credit note reduces; icon and colour follow the status.

onIssue.note: Draft: Issue invoice, the solid primary.

onRecordPayment.note: Issued or overdue: Record payment, the solid primary.

requirements: status is a word in a kit Badge
bill-to, dates and totals are description lists
the footnote states paid, overdue or voided in words
void dims the lines and strikes through the total; the badge and footnote say Void

doNot: Do not invent a local InvoiceView or CreditNoteCard
Do not show a credit note without the invoice it reduces
Do not show more than one solid primary
snippet: <InvoiceDocument number="INV-2026-0117" status="issued" from="Northwind Ledger Ltd · example issuer" to="Acme Co · 12 Example St" issuedOn="01 Nov 2026" dueOn="15 Nov 2026" lines={lines} subtotal="$652.00" taxLabel="Tax 20%" tax="$130.40" total="$782.40" onDownload={download} onSend={send} onRecordPayment={record} />
